KB BEST Format — Shared Builders and Parser

Komerční banka's BEST format — domestic and foreign payment records and the electronic statement — shared by the KB BEST payment export and statement import.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount_cz_bankfile_base
Extended byaccount_payment_kb_best, account_statement_import_kb_best
This module is part of a family documented in one place. The full guide: account_payment_kb_best

Writes BEST payment files (domestic 01 records, foreign/SEPA 02 records with the 03 address) and reads BEST statements (51 turnover, 52 transactions), applying KB's own rules before the bank does: KB debit account only, unique daily sequence numbers, refused constant symbols, SEPA and EEA charge rules.

It has no screen and no settings. It is installed as a dependency of account_payment_kb_best and account_statement_import_kb_best.
